title: [PTRun][Calculator] Persist copied results without a post-write OLE flush

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The focused diagnostic on clean exact upstream source reproduced cswinrt.exe exit -1073740791 and preserved its invocation and empty-input response file. MSBuild downgraded the failure under ContinueOnError and returned zero, so the private runner incorrectly continued. The unit-test build reported success, but VSTest exited one because the supplied DLL was absent. No TRX or executed test counts were produced. All children exited and a subsequent runaway wrapper was stopped. The repaired private entrypoint now passes six inert scenarios covering the warning-masked crash, nonzero exits, exceptions, missing DLL, TargetPath arguments and exactly-once disposal. Those checks used no build, test tool or lock. The projection crash remains unresolved, not an established upstream defect; no product validation pass or review conclusion is claimed.
